reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text: Really enjoyed this serum! It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin a healthy glow.Gentle on my sensitive skin and definitely worth trying.
reviews.zh: 真心鍾意呢支精華！質地輕，吸收得快，畀到我皮膚健康嘅光澤。對我敏感肌都好溫和，絕對值得一試。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text:
柑橘系の匂いがよく、テクスチャーは少し硬めで塗り心地がいいです。塗り続けると肌のトーンが少しずつ明るくなる気がします。
ただ、私の肌には刺激が強いのか、強い紫外線を浴びた後や肌の荒れている時につけると所々炎症のような赤みが出てきます。本当は毎日塗りたいのですが、弱い肌の人は毎日使用するのは難しそうです。肌の状態が落ち着いている時にトーンアップを目指して塗っています。
reviews.zh:
柑橘味好香，質地少杰，塗上皮膚感覺舒服。持續用落感覺膚色慢慢變亮。
不過可能對我塊皮膚嚟講太刺激，接觸過強紫外線之後或者皮膚狀態差嘅時候搽，會局部出現好似發炎嘅紅斑。本來想日日搽，但膚質較弱嘅人日日用似乎比較難。我而家會等皮膚狀態穩定嗰陣先用，目標係想提亮膚色。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text: I love how refreshing this serum feels every morning. It sinks into the skin fast and doesn’t leave any sticky residue. With regular use, my complexion looked brighter and old blemish marks became less noticeable. It layers well with moisturizer and sunscreen, making it easy to use every day.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意朝早用呢支精華嘅清爽感。佢快速滲入皮膚，唔會留低黏笠感。持續用落，膚色睇落更亮，舊有嘅暗瘡印都冇咁顯眼。搽完保濕同防曬都好夾，日日用都好方便。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text: Haven't been using this for very long, but I love how refreshing it is and a lovely lightweight texture that absorbs so well. I've only heard good things about it, so I have faith it will be great for my skin as well.
reviews.zh: 雖然用咗冇耐，但我好鍾意佢嘅清爽感，質地輕盈，吸收得好好。我淨係聽過好嘅評價，所以有信心佢都會啱我嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text: Lightweight and gentle serum that absorbs quickly. I'm using it for deep pigmentation, so it's too early to see results, but I'm hopeful it will improve my dark spots with continued use.
reviews.zh: 精華質地輕盈溫和，吸收得快。我用佢對付深層色斑，所以仲太早見到效果，但我有期望持續用可以改善我嘅色斑。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text: Unfortunately the package was damaged and I haven’t really tried it but it got in my hands when handling it and I can tell that has a nice texture and absorbs quickly but it’s kinda sticky, such a shame I couldn’t enjoy it
reviews.zh: 可惜包裝損壞了，我未真正試用過，但上手處理時已感覺到質地不錯、吸收得快，不過有點黏笠，實在可惜未能好好享受。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text: “Love this set! The serum is lightweight, absorbs fast, and smells like fresh oranges. I’ve been using it for a few weeks and noticed my dark spots fading slightly, plus my skin looks more radiant. The extra 35ml is a great bonus. Non-irritating even for my slightly sensitive skin.”
reviews.zh: 「好喜歡呢套裝！精華質地輕盈，吸收快，聞落有清新橙味。用咗幾星期，發現色斑有少許淡化，皮膚望落更有光澤。多送嘅 35ml 真係大加分。連我呢種略為敏感肌都唔覺刺激。」

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Serum α 50ml Set (+35ml)
reviews.text: Will not repurchase. The vitamin c concentration is not high enough. It does absorb well and I do layer it. Weill have to keep using to sure results
reviews.zh: 唔會回購。維他命 C 濃度唔夠高。吸收係幾好，我都會疊用。要繼續用落去先可以肯定效果。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
